name: Raspberry Pi 4B + microSD + cooling
purpose: Ground gateway: TAK ingest, Ghost decode, MGRS, validity and display updates.
endpoints: Wi-Fi/Ethernet ↔ TAK; USB-A ← U2; GPIO 8/10 ↔ AM_osd J3.4/3.
status: Suitable by architecture; no live benchmark or unit reservation.

name: AM_osd inline rev 0.3 family
purpose: Maintain PAL/NTSC sync and composite the HUD into video.
status: Repository baseline; installed board/image and video acceptance remain checks.

name: 2 × bare 8P8C/RJ45 breakout + short CAT6 lead
purpose: Expose the numbered MATRIX contacts while retaining pair geometry.
endpoints: J_RADIO toward GU QS; J_TAC toward TAC. 1–6 straight-through; 7/8 via K1.
status: No Ethernet magnetics, PoE splitter or breakout with hidden circuitry. 50 V-rated assembly/insulation.

name: TI THVD1450D receiver circuit / breakout
purpose: Candidate high-impedance differential-UART → 3.3 V receive-only conversion.
endpoints: A6 ← MATRIX 6; B7 ← MATRIX 3; R1 → U2 RXD; VCC8 ← Pi 3V3; DE3 tied low.
status: Conditional on common-mode/polarity/loading measurement. No onboard termination/bias left across operating link.

name: USB-to-3.3 V UART adapter
purpose: Give the Pi a second serial input without sharing its AM_osd UART.
endpoints: RXD ← U1 R1; GND → G0; USB → Pi USB-A. TXD and power lead insulated.
status: Select a documented 3.3 V logic adapter (e.g. FTDI class). Connector pin order depends on product.

name: AD8130-based differential CVBS receiver / evaluation circuit
purpose: Candidate conversion from MATRIX video pair to single-ended CVBS; matched gain/equalization.
endpoints: IN− ← radio-side MATRIX 7; IN+ ← 8 through K1A; CVBS OUT → OSD J1.3; return → G0.
status: Functional ports shown. No resistor values, supply rails or IC package wiring released until levels are measured.

name: AD8132-based differential CVBS driver / evaluation circuit
purpose: Candidate reconstruction of the original differential video for TAC.
endpoints: CVBS IN ← OSD J2.3; OUT− / OUT+ → TAC 7 / 8 through K1B; return → G0.
status: Output swing, common mode, source impedance and equalization must match the original link.

name: 4-pole video transfer: two DPDT signal relays or one 4PDT switch
purpose: Restore the original 7/8 pair and disconnect both adapter ends during bypass.
endpoints: Input poles COM=radio 7/8; NO=V1 N/P. Output poles COM=TAC 7/8; NO=V2 N/P. Corresponding NCs joined.
status: Choose/test for CVBS bandwidth/contact parasitics. Relay coils default off; future hardware watchdog, not Pi software alone.

name: Independent Pi USB-C PSU + regulated OSD supply + analog bench rails
purpose: Keep local prototype power independent of MATRIX 50 V.
endpoints: Pi USB-C: 5 V/3 A; OSD J3.1: regulated +5 V; analog rails per evaluated V1/V2 circuit; returns join G0.
status: Do not power OSD from a 3V3 pin. Check grounding/backfeed; MATRIX 4 remains pass-through only.

name: Differential oscilloscope measurement + PAL source/monitor
purpose: Establish video/data common mode, polarity, sync, loading, termination and overlay latency.
endpoints: MATRIX 3/6 and 7/8, OSD J1.3/J2.3 and G0; start isolated from MATRIX.
status: Required validation equipment; ownership/availability not established in relevant inventory.

name: Optional second U1/U2 receiver channel for C2
purpose: Later decode RC page-selector state without transmitting or breaking control continuity.
endpoints: MATRIX 2 → A6; MATRIX 1 → B7; R1 → separate USB UART RXD.
status: Deferred; local Pi UI selects pages first. No new AUX assigned.
